title: Nine Feet of Painting
subtitle: 宗教信仰 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 宗教信仰（历史社会与文化·宗教与信仰）
meta: 主题语境：宗教信仰（历史社会与文化·宗教与信仰）　|　核心词汇：church　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 church 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to paint ① church she could not enter, and she said the painting was the whole of the lesson. The ② church, meaning the building and not the faith, was nine feet high and was painted by whoever came last; church, she said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ church in that village had the same bell, and the ④ church at the end, meaning the one the vicar kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted properly. Church, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ church was the whole of the Sunday, meaning the faith it carried and not the building. The ⑥ church, meaning the faith and not any of that, is the only thing in a Sunday that everybody attends and nobody questions; church, he said, is either something you paint or the only word that means both a building and a faith. She said the faith is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ church had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the bell. The ⑧ church of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of painting; church, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ church I remember is the one at the end, which was painted in 1966 and is still described as the oldest in the county. A ⑩ church, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being painted; every church, she said, is a faith that has agreed to look like a building. She said the faith was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 教堂（指那座建筑本身，与那份信仰相对）
C. 固定搭配：paint a church 粉刷一座教堂
D. n. 教堂（指那个村子里每一座）
E. n. 教堂（指末尾那一座）
F. n. 信仰（抽象：它承载的那份信念）
G. n. 那份信念（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The church, meaning the building and not the faith
church was the whole of the Sunday
the church had become a number in a report
The church of the whole thing
A church, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: paint a church 意为“粉刷一座教堂”，1946 年母亲被派去粉刷她进不去的那座教堂。
church 意为“教堂、礼拜堂”，指那座建筑本身而不是那份信仰，高九英尺，由最后来的人粉刷。
church 指那个村子里每一座教堂，每一座都是同样的钟。
church 指末尾那一座（牧师留下的那一座），是唯一有人认真粉刷过的。
church 意为“信仰”，抽象指它承载的那份信念，父亲说 church 就是那个星期天的全部。
church 为抽象用法，指那份信念本身，是一个星期天里人人都参加、却没人质疑的东西。
church 意为“教堂、礼拜堂”，到 1961 年这座 church 成了报告里的一个数字。
church 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的粉刷。
church 意为“教堂”，我记得的是末尾那一座，1966 年粉刷过，至今仍被说成全县最古老的。
church 为抽象总称，祖母说一座教堂是唯一会因为被认真粉刷而变好的东西。
